newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault 1996 unit sales up 1.65 pct.
newsitem.headline: Renault 1996 unit sales up 1.65 pct.

text.p: Renault SA said on Friday that its worldwide sales rose 1.65 percent to 1.85 million vehicles in 1996 from 1.82 million in 1995.
Sales of cars rose 3.27 percent to 1.57 million units, sales of light commercial vehicles fell 3.36 percent to 216,150 units and sales of trucks and buses fell 15.96 percent to 63,679.

Renault said total vehicle production was down 1.86 percent to 1.80 million units. Car production rose 0.35 percent to 1.52 million units, light commercial vehicle output fell 10.74 percent to 217,210 and truck and bus output fell 17.53 percent to 62,843.
